main_text.p:
11. Nunc autem scripsi vobis non commisce-
ri: si quis frater nominatus aut scortator, aut
maledicus, aut avarus aut idololatra, aut ebrio-
sus, aut rapax, cum eiusmodi neque comedere.

12. Quid enim mihi et eos qui foris iudicare?
nonne qui intus sunt, vos iudicatis? ^ foris

13. Eos autem qui foris, deus iudicabit: et
auferte malum ex vobis ipsis.

page.notes: Marginal and interlinear marks: "foris" struck through with an insertion caret after "sunt" in verse 12; a caret above "autem" in verse 13; "intus" partly struck and underlined "Quid" in verse 12 are manuscript-like corrections, transcribed as they appear. Right margin is a dark stained edge with no text. Page is cut off below; the remainder is not transcribed.
